hero.title: Compare Engine Replacement Services in the UK

blocks.text: Find the right engine for your vehicle — used, reconditioned, rebuilt, or remanufactured. Compare quotes from 100+ vetted UK specialists. Free, no obligation.

links.text: Replacement Engines Compare all engine types — used, reconditioned, rebuilt, and new. Find the perfect match for your vehicle and budget. Most Popular 24,650 quotes
Used Engines Budget-friendly option. Salvaged from donor vehicles with verified mileage. Ideal for older cars or short-term ownership. Budget From £400
Reconditioned Engines Stripped, inspected, and rebuilt with new parts. Includes 12-24 month warranty. The most requested option in 2025. Best Value 70.45% chose this
Rebuilt Engines Full strip-down, machining, and assembly using upgraded components. Ideal for long-term ownership and high-performance vehicles. Premium 12-24 mo warranty
Remanufactured Engines Factory-spec rebuild using new parts throughout. Meets OEM standards. Best for insurance claims or high-value vehicles. OEM Spec Full factory warranty
Supply & Fit Complete service — engine supply, delivery, and professional fitting by vetted specialists. One quote covers everything. All-in-One Fully managed
Engine Fitting Professional installation by UK specialists. Labour costs from £65/hr (indie) to £110/hr+ (dealer). Regional variations apply. Labour 8-15 hours
Engine Repair Targeted repairs for isolated failures — timing chains, head gaskets, turbos, injectors, and more. Cheaper than full replacement. Save Money Repair from £300
Engine Diagnostics Identify the root cause of your engine problem. Professional diagnostics from £50-£150. Catch failures before they escalate. First Step £50-£150
Vehicle Recovery Stranded due to engine failure? Arrange recovery to your chosen garage or specialist. UK-wide coverage available. Emergency UK-wide
Gearbox Replacement Full gearbox replacement for manual, automatic, and semi-automatic transmissions. Compare quotes from UK specialists. Transmission From £800
Automatic Gearbox Replacement Specialist automatic transmission replacement. Includes DSG, CVT, torque converter, and dual-clutch systems. Auto Specialist required
Manual Gearbox Replacement Manual transmission replacement and repair. Clutch kits, flywheels, and full gearbox swaps available. Manual Wide availability
